input clk, slave_wait, clk_cnt; 
  input cmd; 
  output reg cmd_stop; 
  reg clk_en; 
  output reg [15:0] cnt; 
  always @(posedge clk) 
  if (~|cnt) 
  if (~slave_wait)

  cnt <= #1 clk_cnt; 
  clk_en <= #1 1'b1;

  cnt <= #1 cnt; 
  clk_en <= #1 1'b0; 
  end 
  else 
  begin 
  cnt <= #1 cnt - 16'h1; 
  clk_en <= #1 1'b0; 
  end 
  always @(posedge clk) 
  if (clk_en)
